steps.code:
# Create a set of liked song IDs for quick lookup.
liked_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in liked_songs}
print("Liked IDs:", liked_ids)

# We'll loop: call previous_song, then check the new current song.
# We'll keep track of how many steps we take to avoid infinite loop.
max_steps = 10
for i in range(max_steps):
    # Go to previous song
    prev_result = apis.spotify.previous_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Step", i+1, "previous_song result:", prev_result)
    # Get the new current song
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("New current song:", current)
    if current['song_id'] in liked_ids:
        print("Found liked song:", current['title'])
        # We can break and later complete the task with this song info.
        break
else:
    print("Did not find a liked song within", max_steps, "steps")
